##  Documents Required
  1. POI/POA Documents Required   
1.1[ Indian Citizen](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/documents-form_93-form_94.html)  
1.2[ Foreign Citizen/NRI](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/services/pan/foreign-citizen.html)  

  2. [Additional document for Change/Correction](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/Additional-Documents.pdf)
  3. [Annexure A_Prescribed format of Certificate of identity /address issued by MP/MLA/Municipal Councillor/Gazetted Officer](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/Annexure%20A_Prescribed%20format%20of%20Certificate%20issued%20for%20Indetity%20&%20Address%20by%20MPMLA%20Municipal%20Coun.pdf)
  4. [Prescribed format of Certificate issued by the Employer on the letter head of the organization / institution](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/Annexure%20B.pdf)
  5. [Prescribed format of Certificate of identification issued by the Bank on the letter head of the bank](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/Annexure%20C_03022014.pdf)
  6. [Certification for individuals not being a Citizen of India & entities incorporated outside India filling form no. 95 or 96 ](https://tinpan.proteantech.in/downloads/pan/Certification%20for%20%20individuals%20not%20being%20a%20Citizen%20of%20India%20&%20entities%20incorporated%20outside%20India%20filling%20form%20no.%2095%20or%2096.pdf)
  7. Online application form (with photo &/or signature affixed) and Prescribed supporting documents (except for e-Sign/DSC based applications) should be sent to **Protean eGov Technologies Limited** , Income Tax PAN Services Unit, 4th floor, Sapphire Chambers, Baner Road, Baner, Pune - 411045
